description: A step of the probe prints a marker and pulls an old image on one line: `echo "#1" && docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble`. The `#` stands inside quotes, so YAML reads no comment there. A strip that cut every line at its first `#` hid the pull behind it.

workflows..github/workflows/e2e-probe.yml:
jobs:
  probe:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: npx playwright test "$@"
      - run: echo "#1" && docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble
